title: Not very durable
text: Not very durable. The first time I used one and it was packed with beach towels, the handle tore off when I lifted the bag.  Now when I store blankets and comforters in them, I make sure I support the bottom instead of lifting by the handles.  They're not airtight, but good for keeping the dust off of items that will be stored for awhile.
